item.title: EBU and Superpositions Partner to Add Quantum Computing to Business Education
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – EBU (European Business Institute of Luxembourg) and Superpositions, a European quantum software company, recently announced a partnership to bring quantum computing into EBU’s business curriculum, as part of the school’s new Q-Ready initiative.
